enter_plan_mode.description: Enter planning mode. No tool access — text only. Design approach before making change. Call exit_plan_mode when ready.

exit_plan_mode.description: Leave planning mode, resume tool access. Call after plan designed.

parameters.summary: Brief summary of plan to execute.

enable_tools.description: REQUIRED after search_tools: activate found tool for use. Without this, found tool UNAVAILABLE. Accept exact tool name (e.g. "get_weather") or domain prefix (e.g. "domain:Finance") to enable entire group. Enabled tool ready NEXT turn.

parameters.tools: Tool name or domain prefix to enable. e.g. ["get_weather", "get_weather_forecast"] or ["domain:Weather & Environment"].

disable_tools.description: Deactivate tool from session to free context. Accept exact name or domain prefix. Core tool (memory, task, plan, orchestration) can't be disabled.

parameters.tools: Tool name or domain prefix to disable. e.g. ["get_weather"] or ["domain:Weather & Environment"].

discover_and_enable_tools.description: Search ALL tool ({{totalToolCount}}) AND enable match in one step. Combines search_tools + enable_tools — found tool ready next turn. Covers: {{domainListLowercase}}.

parameters.query: Search term to match tool name and description. Use specific term. e.g. {{sampleKeywords}}.

create_skill.description: Create reusable workflow recipe. Skill = saved instruction with placeholder ({{variable}}) callable by name. Capture multi-step workflow (fix->test->commit, analyze->report) as single action. Persists across session.

parameters.name: Unique skill name (e.g. 'fix_and_test', 'code_review'). Serves as ID.
parameters.description: What skill does — shown when listing.
parameters.prompt: Instruction to execute. Use {{variable}} for placeholder.
parameters.steps: Optional: ordered step list for documentation.
parameters.tools: Optional: specific tool to enable. If omitted, all available.
parameters.maxIterations: Optional: max iteration for skill execution (1-100). Default: 25.
parameters.model: Optional: different model for skill execution.

execute_skill.description: Run previously created skill by ID. Instruction populated with variable and executed. Use list_skills to see available.

parameters.variables: Key-value pair for {{variable}} placeholder in skill instruction.

list_skills.description: List all available skill created with create_skill.

enter_worktree.description: Enter isolated worktree for this session. Creates branch, redirects file/git/command tool to separate directory. Use for risky change, experiment, or speculative edit without affecting main branch. Call exit_worktree to merge or discard.

exit_worktree.description: Leave worktree, return to main. Choose 'merge' to keep change or 'discard' to drop.

parameters.commitMessage: Commit message for merge. Auto-generated if omitted.

write_todo.description: Write or update todo list for current project. Track multi-step work with persistent checklist. Each item: 'pending', 'in_progress', or 'completed'. Call with full updated list — replaces previous.

summarize_conversation.description: Compress current conversation into summary. Use when conversation grows long. Summary stored for future turn — not user-visible.

parameters.summary: Compressed summary. Include: key decision, file changed, task status, remaining work.
parameters.keyFiles: Optional: important file path for current work.

ask_user.description: Ask user question and wait for response. Use for clarification, choice, or confirmation before major action. Agent loop pauses until answered. Batch up to 4 question per call.

parameters.context: Optional: extra context shown below question.
parameters.questions: Question batch (up to 4). Each item is question object.

list_mcp_resources.description: List available resource from connected MCP server.

parameters.server_name: MCP server name. If omitted, query all.

read_mcp_resource.description: Read specific resource from MCP server by URI.

parameters.token: Bearer token for HTTP MCP server.

set_timer.description: Set short wait timer for in-session pause. Use when waiting for async operation, checking build, retrying after failure. Timer fires prompt back into conversation after duration. Must be 30-599 second (under 10 min). For user reminder or alarm, use create_cron_job instead.

parameters.prompt: Instruction fired back when timer triggers.

list_timers.description: List active wait timer in current session. For user reminder, use list_cron_jobs.

cancel_timer.description: Cancel active wait timer. For cron job, use delete_cron_job.

search_conversations.description: Search past session using natural language. Semantic match returns title, summary, date, linked memory count. Use when user says 'remember when...' or needs prior session context.

parameters.query: Search term in plain language. e.g. 'MCP connection debug', 'session where we fixed WebSocket drop'.
